name: run_id
description: Immutable run identifier, derived by the runtime from the normalized configuration and input identities. Also the object prefix in the artifact bucket and the merge key of this table.

name: state
description: Terminal run state as reported by status.json. Only SUCCEEDED runs are published by the adapter; FAILED rows arrive only when a failure is published deliberately.

name: created_at
description: When the run was created, from status.json. The partitioning column of this table.

name: completed_at
description: When the run reached its terminal state. Null for a run that never reached one.

name: git_commit
description: Commit that produced the run. Null rather than guessed when the runtime had no repository available.

name: config_digest
description: SHA-256 of the normalized experiment configuration. Two runs with the same digest ran the same experiment.

name: model_id
description: Model identifier, as passed to the extractor.

name: model_revision
description: Pinned model revision. Null means the run did not pin one, which makes its embeddings irreproducible; it is recorded as null rather than filled in with a resolved value the run did not actually use.

name: scales_digest
description: Digest of the scale definitions. The orderings are the ground truth, so a changed digest means the benchmark changed, not the model.

name: background_digest
description: Digest of the background corpus used to estimate dominant directions.

name: container_digest
description: Digest of the image that executed the run, when the image supplied one.

name: device
description: Device string used for extraction, for example cpu or cuda. Embeddings are not bit-identical across devices.

name: duration_seconds
description: Wall-clock duration of the run, taken from status.json or the manifest, whichever the runtime filled. Never computed from the two timestamps, which may not mean the same thing.

name: artifact_uri
description: gs:// prefix holding the uploaded run directory. Set by the adapter, not by the runtime.

name: error_code
description: Machine-readable failure code from status.json. Null for a successful run.
